## What the fault was

`src/verification-defect.ts` contained a bare top-level `throw`, and `src/worker.ts` line 1 had a side-effect import of it:

```ts
import './verification-defect.ts';
```

A top-level `throw` runs at **module-evaluation time**, so merely naming the module in an import list aborted process startup. Since `src/cli.ts` imports `./worker.ts` and `scripts/build.mjs` bundles from `src/cli.ts`, esbuild inlined the throw to `dist/worker.cjs` line 1 — which is exactly why iteration 1-1 died at `(/worker.cjs:1:7)` before `runIteration()` was ever entered, leaving no `result.json` and an invalid journal.

- Deleted `src/verification-defect.ts`
